displayedInputs.question:
A bug travels from \(A\) to \(B\) along the segments in the hexagonal lattice pictured below. The segments marked with an arrow can be traveled only in the direction of the arrow, and the bug never travels the same segment more than once. How many different paths are there?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

In the diagram, all angles are right angles and the lengths of the sides are given in centimeters. Note the diagram is not drawn to scale. What is \(X\), in centimeters?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

A circle of radius \(2\) is cut into four congruent arcs. The four arcs are joined to form the star figure shown. What is the ratio of the area of the star figure to the area of the original circle?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

A square with area \(4\) is inscribed in a square with area \(5\), with one vertex of the smaller square on each side of the larger square. A vertex of the smaller square divides a side of the larger square into two segments, one of length \(a\) and the other of length \(b\). What is the value of \( ab ?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

Square \(ABCD\) has side length \(10.\) Point \(E\) is on \(\overline{BC},\) and the area of \(\triangle ABE\) is \(40.\) What is \(BE?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

In \(\triangle ABC,\) \(AB=AC=28\) and \(BC=20.\) Points \(D,\) \(E,\) and \(F\) are on sides \(\overline{AB},\) \(\overline{BC},\) and \(\overline{AC},\) respectively, such that \(\overline{DE}\) and \(\overline{EF}\) are parallel to \(\overline{AC}\) and \(\overline{AB},\) respectively. What is the perimeter of parallelogram \(ADEF?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

In triangle \(\triangle ABC,\) medians \(AD\) and \(CE\) intersect at \(P,\) \(PE=1.5,\) \(PD=2,\) and \(DE=2.5.\) What is the area of \(AEDC?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

The regular octagon \(ABCDEFGH\) has its center at \(J.\) Each of the vertices and the center are to be associated with one of the digits \(1\) through \(9,\) with each digit used once, in such a way that the sums of the numbers on the lines \(AJE,\) \(BJF,\) \(CJG,\) and \(DJH\) are all equal. In how many ways can this be done?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
